## Summary

## Checklist

- [ ] English only.
- [ ] `spec check` is clean.
- [ ] No secrets, personal email addresses, or `Co-authored-by` trailers with a non-noreply address in the commits, the title, or this body.
- [ ] The diff does not publish `.spec/`, `.agents/`, `AGENTS.md`, or source maps in the docs site or the npm tarball.
- [ ] Third-party actions are full commit SHAs with version comments. New packages follow the supply-chain adoption rule.
- [ ] Agent manifests are generated from `schema/agent-surface`. No plugin-registry submission.
